name: Bootstrap External Link Pop-up
description: Renders the External Link Pop-up module's outbound-link confirmation using a Bootstrap modal instead of the jQuery UI dialog.
project_description: The Bootstrap External Link Pop-up module extends the External Link Pop-up module and replaces its jQuery UI popup dialog with Bootstrap's modal dialog. It is helpful when the frontend theme is built on the Bootstrap framework, so the leaving-site confirmation matches the rest of the site without extra styling. The module carries no configuration of its own: all pop-up messages, titles, buttons and trusted-domain settings are managed on the parent External Link Pop-up module's admin screens. It provides a Twig template (bootstrap_external_link_popup.html.twig) rendering an empty Bootstrap modal into the page bottom, and a JavaScript library that overrides the parent module's openDialog behavior to populate and show that modal (supporting both Bootstrap 4 and Bootstrap 5 initialisation). The module does not ship the Bootstrap CSS/JS itself; the active theme (for example Radix or Barrio) must provide them.
